{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print("Sentinel value (-1) count:", (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check for invalid revenue rows (QA orders)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print("QA orders count:", len(qa_orders))

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print("Refunded orders count:", len(refunded_orders))

# Check for channel imbalance
channel_counts = df['channel'].value_counts()
print("Channel counts:\n", channel_counts)"}
